inbox.title: Inbox

inbox.caption: Documents

filters.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

empty.processing: No document is in the pipeline right now.
empty.all: Upload a file or connect a channel to receive documents.

upload.title: Upload documents

upload.dropzone: Drop files here or press Enter to choose files
upload.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than {{max}} and was skipped.

review.notFoundDescription: It does not exist or belongs to another tenant.
review.settledDescription: It is {{status}}; its fields can no longer be edited.
review.noCanonical: This document type has no form to review yet: its fields can be reviewed once the type is set up under Settings > Document types.
review.noCanonicalExtracted: Extraction produced no data for this document; see the failure above, or reprocess it once the cause is fixed.
review.noCanonicalProcessing: The pipeline is still working on this document; the fields appear when extraction has finished.

flags.hint: Click a flag or press j / k to jump to its field.
flags.hintTouch: Tap a flag to jump to its field.
flags.none: No flags: every validation rule passed.
flags.notValidated: Not validated yet: flags appear once the document has passed the Validate stage.
flags.stale: Corrections not re-validated: reprocess from Validate to re-check.
flags.staleSettled: Corrections were not re-validated before the decision.
flags.notOnPageHint: The value was not found in the page text, so there is no box on the page to highlight.

leave.title: Discard your corrections?
leave.description: Your corrections on this document are not saved. Leaving it discards them.

actions.label: Review actions
actions.approveDescription: {{number}} will be approved and handed to the downstream systems.
actions.rejectDescription: Rejected documents are not exported. The reason is recorded in the timeline.
actions.rejectReasonPlaceholder: For example: duplicate of an invoice already paid
actions.reprocessDescription: The document is sent back through the pipeline from the selected stage; corrections made after that stage are recomputed.
actions.useCurrentVersion: Use the published version of the type
actions.useCurrentVersionNewer: This document was read with {{type}} v{{version}}; v{{published}} is published. Without this, the document keeps v{{version}}.
actions.useCurrentVersionSame: This document was read with {{type}} v{{version}}, the published version.
actions.saveFirst: Save or discard your corrections first.

approveBlocked.TYPE_REQUIRED: Set the type of this document before approving it: an Unknown document has no fields to deliver.
approveBlocked.NO_DEFINITION: This type has no published definition; publish it or set another type before approving.
approveBlocked.NO_DATA: Nothing was captured yet: none of the fields holds a value. Fill the fields before approving.

actions.approvedAndSaved: Document approved and saved as a layout.
actions.saveAsLayoutOff: The document is approved only; the new-layout flag is resolved as approved without a layout.
actions.saveAsLayoutPending: Confirms the pending layout with this document (no second layout).
actions.saveAsLayoutVersion: Saves a new version of the chosen layout.
actions.saveAsLayoutNew: Saves the identifiers and field positions as {{layout}} ({{rule}}).
actions.ruleProposed: rule proposed from the title and the VAT id
actions.layoutRefused: The layout could not be saved; the document was not approved

layoutRefusedCode.RULE_INVALID: The identification rule is not valid.
layoutRefusedCode.RULE_DOES_NOT_HOLD: The identification rule does not hold on this document.
layoutRefusedCode.LAYOUT_EXISTS: The supplier has a layout with this key for this type already.
layoutRefusedCode.LAYOUT_NOT_RECOGNISED: The new version no longer recognises documents of the old design; confirm that in the New layout panel.
layoutRefusedCode.NOT_LEARNABLE: This document cannot be saved as a layout.
layoutRefusedCode.NOTHING_LEARNED: No value could be learned with its place on the page; map the values from the page first.
layoutRefusedCode.TARGET_NOT_FOUND: The layout to replace was not found.
layoutRefusedCode.PENDING_NOT_FOUND: The pending layout was not found.

viewer.pageError: The page image could not be loaded.
viewer.noPages: This document has no rendered pages (an XML e-invoice, for example); its data is in the fields.
viewer.mapModeHint: Map from page (M): click words or drag a box to fill the focused field
viewer.tableToolHint: Table tool: draw the table once and apply it to all pages
viewer.identifyModeHint: Mark the words that identify this design (I)

map.ocrNotConfigured: No OCR is configured on this server, so a region without text cannot be read; type the value into the field.
map.focusFirst: Click the field to fill in the form first.

table.start: Draw the table on the page

setType.title: Change type
setType.description: The document is pinned to the published version of the type you pick; a correction records the change.
setType.none: The tenant has no type with a published version. An admin adopts or publishes one under Settings > Document types.
setType.emptyHint: Every field of the type is empty; fill them from the page (map mode and the table tool) or by typing.
setType.autoHint: The document is read again for the type (it goes back through extraction) and comes back to review.
setType.queued: The document is read again as a {{type}}.

supplier.assignDescription: The supplier stays assigned on every later run of the pipeline; the document is checked again with it.
supplier.createDescription: Filled from the supplier on the document where it was captured. The supplier is created and assigned in one step.
supplier.name: Name
supplier.adminOnly: E-mail domains and aliases, which match later documents to this supplier, are added by a tenant admin under Suppliers.

split.title: Split into documents
split.description: Tick the pages where a new document starts. Each part is classified again, or extracted at once for the type you give it.
split.startsAt: A new document starts at page {{page}}
split.done_one: Split into {{count}} document; the parts are being processed.
split.done_other: Split into {{count}} documents; the parts are being processed.

join.title: Join parts
join.description: Parts of the same attachment that, with this one, make one run of pages become one document again; the others are cancelled with a link to it.
join.none: This attachment has no other part to join.
join.done_one: {{count}} part joined; the document is being classified again.
join.done_other: {{count}} parts joined; the document is being classified again.

mapDocument.title: Map this document
mapDocument.unknown: The document type was not recognised. Pick its type and start empty, to capture the values from the page, or let AI pre-fill it.
mapDocument.noForm: {{type}} has no form to review. Give the document a type with fields: start empty, to capture the values from the page, or let AI pre-fill it.
mapDocument.noData: Nothing was captured for this {{type}} yet. Read it again for its type (Let AI pre-fill), or start empty to capture the values from the page.

deliveries.description: Where this document was delivered: one row per binding that matched its approval or rejection. Open a row for its attempts, the receiver's answers and the payload as sent.
deliveries.emptyDescription: No binding matched this document, or it has not been approved or rejected yet.

review.layoutChipHint: The layout that recognised this document and filled its fields

identify.title: Identification
identify.identifiedBy: Recognised by {{layout}}; the highlighted words are its evidence.
identify.hint: Click a word (shift-click adds one) or draw a box around a title or a logo line: it becomes an identifier of this design.
identify.empty: No identifiers marked yet. Without any, saving proposes a rule: the type keyword in the page-1 title and the supplier's VAT id where it is printed.
identify.toggleNegative: Must contain or must not contain
identify.doesNotHold: Does not hold for this document: {{failed}}
identify.recent: Matches {{matched}} of the supplier's last {{tested}} documents
identify.overlapTitle: Also matches documents of other layouts
identify.overlap: Add an identifier that tells them apart: {{layouts}}

newLayout.title: New layout
newLayout.message: {{supplier}} sent a document in a design we have not seen. It was not processed with another layout: match it to a type, check the values and save it as a layout.
newLayout.ambiguous: Layouts of {{supplier}} recognise it equally ({{layouts}}); none was applied. Check the values and approve, or change the layouts' priority in the Suppliers sheet.
newLayout.pending: This matches {{layout}}, a layout saved in review and waiting for activation.
newLayout.pendingHint: Confirming fills the values from the pending layout and adds this document to its replay set; it creates no second layout.
newLayout.typeProposed: The type was proposed by the classifiers; matching confirms it.
newLayout.suggestionHint: Seeds the pre-fill with this layout's labels; its positions are not used
newLayout.saveAsNew: A new layout of this supplier (the existing layouts stay active)
newLayout.saveAsVersion: A new version of an existing layout (a redesign that replaces it)
newLayout.layoutKeyInvalid: Lower-case letters, digits and dashes; at most 64 characters.
newLayout.name: Name
newLayout.versionWarning: Documents in the old design will no longer be recognised once the new version is active; they would go to review as a new layout.
newLayout.confirmNotRecognised: I confirm that the old design will no longer be recognised
newLayout.nothingPrefilled: Nothing could be pre-filled; fill the values from the page in map mode.
newLayout.llmSkipped: No AI filled the rest (none is configured for this tenant, or it could not read the document).

layoutSaved.title: Layout saved
layoutSaved.description: {{layout}} version {{version}} was saved from this document.
layoutSaved.warmup_one: Active: the next document in this design goes to review first (warm-up of {{count}}).
layoutSaved.warmup_other: Active: the next {{count}} documents in this design go to review first (warm-up), already filled by the layout.
layoutSaved.noWarmup: Active: the next document in this design is filled and goes to review only when a check fails.
layoutSaved.candidate: Saved as a candidate: a mapping author activates it after its replay. Documents in this design wait for it.
layoutSaved.identificationPassed: Identification test passed: the rule holds here and on no document of another layout.
layoutSaved.identificationFailed: Identification test failed: the rule also holds on documents of another layout.
layoutSaved.replayFields_one: {{count}} field replayed on {{documents}} documents; lowest agreement {{lowest}} %.
layoutSaved.replayFields_other: {{count}} fields replayed on {{documents}} documents; lowest agreement {{lowest}} %.
layoutSaved.siblingsActive_one: {{count}} more document in review matches this layout.
layoutSaved.siblingsActive_other: {{count}} more documents in review match this layout.
layoutSaved.siblingsCandidate_one: {{count}} more document in review now waits for this layout.
layoutSaved.siblingsCandidate_other: {{count}} more documents in review now wait for this layout.
layoutSaved.notFound: The saved layout could not be found.

queue.title: Review queue
queue.description: Documents waiting for a human decision. Claim a task so nobody else works on it.
queue.caption: Review tasks
queue.empty: No document waits for a review.
queue.reviewersOnlyTitle: The review queue is for reviewers
queue.reviewersOnly: Your role can read documents but not review them. Ask a tenant admin if you should work the queue.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.description: Supplier master data: identifiers that match incoming documents to a supplier.
suppliers.caption: Suppliers
suppliers.createDescription: Identifiers help the pipeline match documents to this supplier.
suppliers.editDescription: Master data and recent documents of this supplier.
suppliers.empty: Suppliers are created as documents arrive, or add one yourself.
suppliers.activityEmpty: No documents from this supplier yet.

fields.name: Name
fields.defaultCurrencyHint: ISO 4217 code, used when a document states no currency.
fields.currencyInvalid: Enter a three-letter currency code such as EUR.
fields.listHint: One per line or separated by commas.
fields.alwaysReviewHint: Documents of this supplier are never auto-approved.
fields.attributesHint: One per line as key = value, such as erpVendorId = V-10042; mappings read them as supplier.attributes.
fields.attributesInvalid: Line {{line}} is not key = value (a key starts with a letter; at most 50 attributes).

suppliers.platformScope: Suppliers belong to a tenant; platform accounts manage a tenant's suppliers in the admin console.

settings.layoutsRequiredHint: A layout-managed supplier's documents are processed only by its layouts; a design none recognises goes to review as a new layout.
settings.allowedTypesHint: A single allowed type is pinned at ingest as set above.

attributes.noSchema: Define the typed attributes in Settings > General; until then edit them as lines in Details.
attributes.noEntities: The tenant has no receiving entities.
attributes.entityRemove: Remove the attributes for this entity

routing.description: Source rules give a document this supplier from where it came from: sender, domain, recipient, channel, folder, subject or file name. All conditions of a rule must hold; sender rules need DMARC unless the rule says otherwise.
routing.emptyDescription: Without one the supplier is found by the document's content (VAT id, IBAN, name).
routing.formHint: At least a sender, a sender domain, a recipient or a channel; a folder prefix needs its channel.

layouts.emptyDescription: Layouts are saved from review ("Approve and save as layout").
layouts.replaySet_one: Replay set: {{count}} document; a field needs {{threshold}} %.
layouts.replaySet_other: Replay set: {{count}} documents; a field needs {{threshold}} %.
layouts.activateDescription: The identification test and the field replay run first; the version Active before is retired.
layouts.reprocessWaiting_one: Reprocess the {{count}} waiting document from Classify
layouts.reprocessWaiting_other: Reprocess the {{count}} waiting documents from Classify
layouts.retireDescription: Documents in this design are no longer recognised by it; they go to review as a new layout.

groups.description: Members inherit a group's attributes and settings (their own win); a group's layouts serve members without their own.
groups.caption: Supplier groups
groups.emptyDescription: Group suppliers that share attributes or layouts.
groups.dialogDescription: The name is unique in the tenant.
groups.saveFailed: The group could not be saved

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Review policy, members, machine access, ingestion channels and AI providers of your organisation.
settings.platformScope: Settings belong to a tenant; platform accounts manage tenants in the admin console.
settings.adminOnly: Ask a tenant admin of your organisation to change the review policy, members, keys, channels or AI providers.

general.identityDescription: Your tenant's identity. Contact the platform operator to change it.
general.policyDescription: When documents are approved automatically and how long they are kept.
general.thresholdHint: Documents without blocking flags whose every field has at least {{value}} confidence are approved automatically.
general.retentionHint: Originals and data are deleted after this many years.
general.shareProfilesHint: Let layout profiles learnt from your documents help other tenants (no document data is shared).

members.caption: Members
members.addDescription: The user ID is the subject of the person's sign-in account.
members.title: Members
members.description: People of your organisation who can sign in to the portal, and what each may do: review documents, manage settings, or only read.

apiKeys.caption: API keys
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key for an integration that uploads or reads documents.
apiKeys.createDescription: The key is shown once after creation; store it in your integration's secret store.
apiKeys.createdDescription: Copy the key now. It cannot be shown again.
apiKeys.copyFailed: The key could not be copied; select it and copy it by hand.
apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let your own systems (an ERP export, a scanner) upload documents or read results through the API, without a personal sign-in.

channels.caption: Channels
channels.emptyDescription: Portal uploads always work; add a mailbox, watched folder or API channel.
channels.createDescription: Where documents come from. Credentials go to the secret store and are never shown again.

configHints.ApiUpload: No settings needed; integrations post to /api/v1/ingestions with an API key.
configHints.Mailbox: IMAP host, port, user name and folder; the password goes into the secret field.
configHints.WatchedFolder: Folder path and file pattern the worker watches.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Where documents come in from: portal upload, a mailbox, a watched folder or the API. Each channel delivers into this organisation.

ai.providersDescription: Bring your own key: documents of your organisation are processed with these providers.
ai.caption: AI providers
ai.emptyDescription: Without one, the platform's provider is used if your policy allows it.
ai.addDescription: The key is validated, stored in the secret store, and only its last four characters are shown afterwards.
ai.enableDescription: Stages that route to it start using it again.
ai.disableDescription: Stages that route to it fall back to the default or fail.
ai.policyDescription: Which provider each pipeline stage uses.

policy.defaultHint: Used by every stage without an override.
policy.fallback: Fall back to the platform key
policy.fallbackHint: When your provider fails, the platform's key is used instead.
policy.fallbackNotAllowed: The platform operator does not allow the platform key for your organisation.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Calls, tokens and estimated cost per day.
usage.emptyDescription: Usage appears once documents are processed with an AI provider.

layouts.title: Layouts and routing
layouts.description: How learned layouts are activated, and how documents are routed to suppliers.
layouts.warmupHint: The first documents under a newly activated layout version go to review, already filled. 5 by default; 0 lets the next one through when every check passes. Active versions on the old value follow.
layouts.agreementHint: The share of the replay set a field must read correctly before a version is activated.
layouts.requiredByDefaultHint: A source-routed supplier whose layouts setting is "inherit" is layout-managed before its first layout exists.
layouts.trustedForwardersHint: Forwards from these domains are unwrapped to their original sender. One per line.
layouts.attributeSchemaHint: Typed attributes of suppliers, groups and entities: properties of type string, number, integer or boolean. Empty removes it.

routing.title: Mail and folder channels
routing.description: Mailboxes and watched folders the worker reads; each document gets the channel's defaults unless a source rule or its content says otherwise.
routing.mailboxHint: Without a server the platform's mail server is read; a server of your own must be public and is reached over TLS.
routing.folderHint: A folder below the tenant's drop zone; a file is taken once its size stayed the same, then moved to processed/ or failed/.
routing.caption: Mail and folder channels
routing.emptyDescription: Add a mailbox or a watched folder to receive documents from it.

fields.unwrapForwards: Unwrap forwarded messages from trusted forwarders

entities.title: Receiving entities
entities.description: Your own companies or branches that documents are addressed to. Outputs read the document's entity; source rules and channels can name one.
entities.caption: Receiving entities
entities.emptyDescription: Add the companies or branches your documents are addressed to.
entities.dialogDescription: The code is unique in the tenant; VAT ids one per line.
entities.saveFailed: The entity could not be saved
entities.deleteDescription: Refused while a document, a source rule, a channel or supplier attributes name it.

governance.goldenDescription: Approved documents whose values are kept as the expected result; replays and regression runs compare against them.
governance.goldenEmptyDescription: Mark an approved document as golden in review.
governance.runsDescription: Run a stored document through a layout version or a draft rule and mapping, or a version through the golden documents. Nothing is written.
governance.bundleDescription: Export types, layouts, source rules, outputs and bindings as signed JSON (no secrets), and import one with a dry run first.

integrations.offTitle: Outputs are off for this tenant
integrations.off: Destinations, output mappings and deliveries need the tenant's outputs switch. A platform administrator switches it on in the admin console (Tenants > Settings > Feature switches).

destinations.title: Destinations
destinations.description: The systems documents are delivered to: an HTTP endpoint that takes one JSON body per document, a folder the file is dropped into, or a pull feed the receiver reads with an API key.
destinations.formDescription: The settings of the transport. The secret (API key, password, token, client secret or signing key) is stored write-only; it is never shown again.
destinations.emptyDescription: Add the receiving system first, then bind an output mapping to it.
destinations.disabled: {{name}} is disabled: nothing is sent to it.
destinations.deleteDescription: A destination that a binding, a delivery or an external reference names cannot be deleted; disable it instead.

transportHints.http: One request per document, retried on network errors, 408, 425, 429 and 5xx.
transportHints.blob: The payload is written as a file below the host's drop folder, never overwriting.
transportHints.pull: Deliveries wait in a feed until the receiver reads and acknowledges them.

problems.headers: Write one header per line as Name: value.
problems.number: Timeouts, status codes and days are whole numbers.

fields.name: Name
fields.sendOriginal: Send the original file as well (multipart: data and file)

hints.urlTemplate: Placeholders in the path or the query only (the host is written out): {{placeholders}}; output.<path> is a value of the rendered payload.
hints.headers: One per line, Name: value. Credentials go to the secret, not here.
hints.responseMapping: A JSONata expression over the receiver's answer whose value is kept as the document's external id.
hints.updateUrlTemplate: Used when a re-approved document is sent as an update (binding: on re-approval Update). Empty: the URL above.
hints.fileNameTemplate: With the same placeholders as the URL; the mapping version's file name wins.
hints.pull: Read with GET /api/v1/feeds/{id} and an API key with the deliveries:read scope; acknowledge with :ack.
hints.secret: Stored in the secret store; never shown again.
hints.secretKeep: A secret is set. Leave this empty to keep it; a new one replaces it and the old one is kept as the previous secret. Moving the URL or the token URL to another host, or changing the auth type or the header name, needs the secret again.

mappings.title: Output mappings
mappings.description: How a document becomes what a receiver imports: a JSONata expression over the document's values, built with the visual field map or written as code, and rendered by the server for the preview and for every delivery.
mappings.createDescription: A mapping of your own starts as an empty visual field map in draft version 1.
mappings.copyDescription: The template's expression and target schema become draft version 1 of your mapping.
mappings.emptyDescription: Copy an integration template below or start a new mapping.

fields.keyHint: Letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-', starting with a letter; not std.
fields.name: Name
fields.sourceTypeHint: The type whose documents the editor offers for the preview.

templates.title: Integration templates
templates.description: Mappings the platform ships: std.event (the thin event) and generic-ap-json (header and rows by role). Copy one to change it.

editor.noValues: Choose a document to see its values.
editor.pickHint: Click a field to put it into the row you are editing.
editor.platformReadOnly: A platform template is read-only; copy it to change it.
editor.noRights: Only an integration admin changes mappings.
editor.publishedReadOnly: A published version does not change; start a new version to edit.
editor.outOfSyncTitle: The code was edited by hand
editor.outOfSync: The expression no longer is what the visual map compiles to, so the map is not shown. Keep working in code, or replace the code with the map (the hand edits are lost).
editor.rebuild: Replace the code with the visual map
editor.noMap: This expression was not built with the visual map.
editor.startMapTitle: Replace the expression with a visual map?
editor.startMapDescription: The expression of this draft is replaced by an empty visual field map. Save only if that is what you want.
editor.codeFromMap: Compiled from the visual map. Editing the code here detaches it from the map.
editor.codeHint: JSONata over the document's values: doc, roles, supplier, entity, source, meta, links. $table, $fmtDate, $fmtNum, $today, $field and $required are available.
editor.schemaInvalid: The target schema is not a JSON object.
editor.schemaHint: Optional JSON Schema of the receiver's format: every preview and every delivery is checked against it.

preview.title: Preview
preview.chooseDocument: Choose a document to render the mapping over.

errorKinds.schema: The target schema is not valid

preview.cut: The output is longer than the preview shows.

problems.targetConflict: A target is both a value and an object (a.b next to a).
problems.sourceInvalid: The source is not a field path.
problems.listEmpty: A list needs at least one field.
problems.formatInvalid: The format's setting is missing or out of range.

fieldMap.requiredPlaceholder: Supplier has no ERP vendor id

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Which documents go where: a binding sends the documents of a type (or of a supplier or channel) through an output mapping to a destination when they are approved or rejected. Price lists can go to the article import while invoices keep going to the AP import.
bindings.formDescription: Every matching binding fires; within an exclusive group only the most specific one does.
bindings.emptyDescription: Bind an output mapping to a destination to start delivering.
bindings.deleteDescription: A binding with deliveries cannot be deleted; disable it instead.

hints.condition: Optional. When it is not true the delivery is listed as Skipped, "not applicable".

lookups.title: Lookup tables
lookups.description: Code tables a mapping reads with $table("key", value, default), such as your ERP's units. An entry can be valid from or until a day. Platform code lists are read-only.
lookups.createDescription: A table of your own; its entries map a value to the receiver's code.
lookups.invalidRow: Row {{row}}: give the value, and dates as yyyy-MM-dd.
lookups.entriesDescription: Each entry maps a value to the receiver's code.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.description: Every delivery of every document: retries wait for their next attempt, a dead letter (a permanent failure, or 15 attempts) waits for a redelivery.
deliveries.emptyDescription: Deliveries appear here when a document matching a binding is approved or rejected.

test.title: Test routing
test.description: A source as ingest sees it, run against the enabled source rules: which supplier it gets and why.
test.subject: Subject
